TAGLINE: A systematic framework for diagnosing and recovering from catastrophic layer sensitivity in transformers — scaling to Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B with true hardware compression.
OVERVIEW: A structured pruning + activation healing pipeline (TIM-MGDT) that identifies which transformer layers are elastic vs critical, prunes the elastic ones, and heals the activation drift — recovering perplexity while cutting parameters, latency, and memory by ~50%.

Existing pruning methods either destroy quality or require expensive retraining. We discovered that Layer 10 in GPT-2 is elastic, not broken — the +108% PPL explosion on hard removal shows over-weighting, not architectural damage. A 2% scaling fix restores balance. TIM-MGDT exploits this insight systematically.

Phase 15 complete. While layer dropping is an established compression method, we discovered that it induces a highly localized representation shift rather than global damage. We introduce Incision Boundary Healing, a routing strategy that targets only the immediate boundaries of the dropped block, recovering up to 4x more perplexity than global baselines.
RESEARCH_Q: Can exhaustive causal sensitivity metrics (ΔCE) reliably identify and exploit layer-level elasticity to achieve lossless (< 5% PPL) structured compression at 50%+ parameter reduction without retraining?
PHASE: Phase 15 Complete. Next: Submit COLM workshop paper.
RUNS: Phase 15 — True Layer Dropping & Boundary Healing
DECISIONS: We proved that calculating the exhaustive ΔCE Bathtub Curve for a 7B model takes under 4 minutes. It is highly actionable.
Instead of dropping scattered layers which causes memory fragmentation, we drop the contiguous 4-layer block with the lowest causal sensitivity to guarantee real-world 15.5% latency reductions.

Layer dropping creates a sharp, localized discontinuity in the activation flow. Healing just the incision boundaries (layers immediately before/after the drop) dramatically outperforms healing globally sensitive layers.
SVD forces dense noise into sparse structures, polluting undamaged weights. Random Init allows the optimizer to find a new sparse-compatible manifold.
To preempt data contamination claims (Wikitext-2), we use C4 evaluation exclusively.
